title: City of Laredo Hosts Inaugural South Texas GIS Day Forum 2026
excerpt: The City of Laredo's 9-1-1 Regional Administration Office and Information Services and Telecommunications Department hosted the inaugural South Texas GIS Day Forum 2026, bringing together geospatial professionals from across the region.
content:
The City of Laredo hosted the inaugural South Texas GIS Day Forum 2026 on Tuesday, bringing together geospatial professionals from across the region to share how mapping technology supports public decision-making and sustainable development.

The forum was hosted by the City's 9-1-1 Regional Administration Office in collaboration with the Information Services and Telecommunications (IST) Department. 9-1-1 Program Manager Amanda Tienda opened the event, and IST Director Joe Rivera gave the welcoming remarks.

Representatives from TAMIU, the City of Roma, United ISD, Jim Hogg County, Zapata County, Laredo ISD, Webb County, Cameron County and Starr County took part, along with other participating agencies and organizations. Attendees exchanged knowledge, shared experiences and saw examples of Geographic Information Systems applications in use across the region.

The City said the forum is part of a broader effort to strengthen regional collaboration and use technology for the benefit of local communities.

Source: City of Laredo, Nov. 18, 2026.
